# FG-REPO-0027

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_pin_behind_the_latest_version_is_neutral_with_spec_version_behind` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このコミットの .forge/repo.yml が固定している仕様の版より新しい版が公開されています。新しい版の変更を確かめ、必要なら version を上げてください。
- en: A later version of a specification this commit's .forge/repo.yml pins has been published. Review its changes and raise version if needed.
- id: Versi yang lebih baru dari spesifikasi yang dipatok oleh .forge/repo.yml pada commit ini telah dipublikasikan. Tinjau perubahannya dan naikkan version bila perlu.

## 原因 (cause)

The check `forge/spec-drift` (M3 X2, plan 03 §5.4, ADR-0023 Amendment X2) evaluated a merge request version's head: an entry `repo: <path>` with `version: <tag>` names a repository every signed-in person may read, and that repository has a later tag of the same series (the same prefix, numbers compared as numbers, a missing part as 0; prerelease tags such as v2.0-rc1 are no versions). A notice, never an HTTP error: the run concludes `neutral` (it never blocks a merge unless a protected branch requires forge/spec-drift, and `neutral` does not satisfy a required check) and its summary and annotation name the line, the pin and the latest version with this code.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Open the run: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head> (forge/spec-drift; the summary lists every entry with its state). The job's log event `forge.spec_drift.recorded` carries `request_id`, `project_id`, `head_sha`, `conclusion` and `check_run_id`. List the referenced repository's tags: gstn browse refs --project <referenced project> --type tag.

## 対処 (fix)

Read the later version's changes and raise `version:` in .forge/repo.yml in this merge request, or keep the pin on purpose (the run stays neutral). Nothing to change on the server.
